questions.question: Which of the following is the most common cause of postpartum hemorrhage?
questions.explanation: Uterine atony (failure of myometrium to contract after delivery) accounts for ~70-80% of primary PPH cases. The 'Four T's' mnemonic places Tone first.

explanations.A: Uterine atony (failure of myometrium to contract after delivery) accounts for ~70-80% of primary PPH cases. The 'Four T's' mnemonic places Tone first.
explanations.B: Retained placental tissue (Tissue) is the second 'T' but less common than atony.
explanations.C: Trauma to the genital tract is third 'T' — typically lacerations of cervix/vagina/perineum.
explanations.D: Thrombin (coagulopathy) is the fourth 'T' and least common cause.
